description: Campus tools and local study workflows.

Get started: Connect TUM MCP to your coding apps and choose optional workflows.
Sign in to the campus services you choose.
Manage: Check connections, workflows, coding apps and the runtime.
Remove workflows, a coding-app registration, or TUM MCP itself.
Manage TUMonline permissions and saved browser profiles.
Update TUM MCP and refresh your coding apps.
Remove saved campus connections from this computer.
List, inspect and customize workflow skills.
Used by your coding agent: Prepare, preview and publish a course app.
Review prepared course content in gated rounds.
Render and maintain explainer videos (Video Notes workflow).
Assemble and publish revision audio (Audio Notes workflow).
List the courses or channels an account can read (JSON).
Run the MCP server over stdio (started by coding apps).

setup.description: Connect TUM MCP to your coding apps and choose optional workflows.
options: codex, claude, cursor, antigravity or generic (writes mcp.json); repeatable.
Use windows to set up a Windows coding app from WSL.  [default: local]

arguments: lecture, audio-notes, video-notes or course-memory; omit to choose.
options: Install local speech-to-text for lectures without captions; models download when first used.
Print machine-readable installation results; requires names.

update.description: Update TUM MCP and refresh your coding apps.
options: Refresh this version without checking npm for a newer release.

uninstall.description: Remove workflows, a coding-app registration, or TUM MCP itself.
arguments: lecture, audio-notes, video-notes or course-memory; omit to choose.
options: Remove only this coding app's registration (codex, claude, cursor, antigravity or generic).
Use windows for a Windows coding app set up from WSL.  [default: local]
With Everything: also remove downloaded runtimes. Close coding apps first.
With Everything: also forget saved campus sign-ins and Git tokens (system credential store entries stay).
